conditions: In an established clan this is already done and costs you nothing.

groups.meta: 3 per Invasion; start crafting the rest now

rows.label: Fieldron
rows.alt: or craft from Fieldron Samples, 12h each

conditions: The recipe wants built Fieldron, not Fieldron Samples. The foundry runs several at once, so queue every crafted one together while you do the Vallis part.
bonuses: Rare Corpus storage containers and tier 4 Orb Vallis bounty stages also drop Fieldron.

disclosures.title: crafting Fieldron
disclosures.body: The Energy Lab Fieldron blueprint costs 15,000 credits. Each build makes 1 Fieldron for 15,000 credits, 10 Fieldron Samples, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage, 250 Plastids and 12 hours. Samples drop from Corpus enemies.

groups.sub: the sperm-shaped pond below the Transit Depot
groups.activity: fish Tromyzon at hotspots in Cold weather; mine and gather nearby

rows.label: Tromyzon Entroplasma
rows.note: 1 per Tromyzon at any quality; dismantle at The Business

rows.label: Heart Noctrul
rows.note: 30 Noctrul (blue veins), 3 refines of 10 at 1,000 cr

conditions: Tromyzon only spawn at an active hotspot (oily green sheen) in Cold weather, never in Warm and never in lakes.
The Heart Noctrul refine blueprint costs 1,000 credits from Smokefinger at Solaris United Neutral.
bonuses: One Tromyzon Bait (300 Solaris United standing, Doer) often yields 14-20+ fish; without bait, about 5 spawn in 8-10 minutes.
Resource Boosters double the Tromyzon you catch.
The Stunna spear's pulse stuns nearby fish; Plains spears work too and still give the Entroplasma.
The area above the pond, between the Enrichment Labs and Transit Depot, is packed with mining nodes.

disclosures.title: when the pond goes quiet
disclosures.body: Switch ponds rather than waiting. The small upper-right pond by the processing facility and the big north-west pond are reliable alternatives. At the sperm pond, stand on the crashed ship or the beach; up to two hotspots spawn and one bait can cover both.

rows.label: Battacor
rows.note: 25,000 cr, 10 Fieldron, 40 Tepa Nodule, 25 Heart Noctrul, 20 Tromyzon Entroplasma

disclosures.title: Sentient Barrage
disclosures.body: Battacor's Nightwave augment isn't needed for the weapon or its Mastery.
